title: Manchester City Faces Sunderland in Decisive Premier League Clash
seoTitle: Man City vs Sunderland: Decisive Premier League Showdown
subtitle: With Jeremy Doku back in the squad and Enzo Maresca's warning, the clash promises to be the toughest of the season for the Blues
excerpt: Manchester City hosts Sunderland at the Etihad Stadium on September 20. Jeremy Doku's return to the squad and Enzo Maresca's warnings raise expectations for the match.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Manchester City FC, BBC, City Xtra
contentHtml:
Manchester City hosts Sunderland at the Etihad Stadium this Sunday, September 20, at 2 PM (British time). The clash is highly anticipated because City's coach considered the opponent the "toughest game of the season" and because Jeremy Doku returns to the squad after injury.

Why the Game is Highly Anticipated

Enzo Maresca's warning, City's coach, about Sunderland's strength and the possibility of Doku playing have captured the attention of the press and fans. The match could extend City's lead in the title race, as the team currently tops the Premier League.

What City's Coach Said

In an interview, Maresca stated that he had observed Sunderland in recent days and noted a very well-organized team, aggressive in duels, and strong both with and without the ball. He emphasized that to win, City would need maximum performance and to be 100% focused on the game.

Jeremy Doku's Return

Jeremy Doku has been re-included in the list of available players for the match after recovering from a calf injury that kept him out of the season's opening fixtures. The forward, who came off at halftime in the 3-0 defeat to Arsenal, might feature in the second half, offering more attacking options to the squad.

City's Recent Performance

Since the victory over Arsenal, City has won six consecutive games across three competitions, including a 5-0 triumph over Norwich in the Carabao Cup. Recent signings like Hugo Viana have already adapted to the club's style, and academy players such as Floyd Samba and Ryan McAidoo have contributed with goals.

Sunderland's Challenge

Sunderland arrived in the Premier League as a surprise last season, finishing seventh and securing a spot in the Europa League. The team has shown solid results, such as draws against Brentford and strong pressure against Arsenal, which keeps City wary of the risk of dropping points.

What's at Stake

A victory over Sunderland would put City three points clear of the second-placed team, consolidating their leadership. Furthermore, the result could impact the team's confidence before facing rivals like Arsenal and Tottenham in the coming weeks.

With information from Manchester City FC, BBC, City Xtra.
